meaning: Compute in Mathlib's real numbers: (1/2)^n is strictly decreasing and positive, so 1 - (1/2)^n is strictly increasing and below 1; (1/2)^n tends to 0, so the stage times tend to 1; the stage gaps are (1/2)^(n+1) by ring arithmetic; the geometric series sum of (1/2)^n is 2, so the durations sum to 1; and a case split on the omega-plus-one moments shows the clock reflects and preserves SupertaskPrecedes.
